confirmed_failure_cause.summary: The v2 stdout observer called Process.exe() on every ancestor before testing its parent PID. On this host the walk reached protected PID 0, whose exe() raises psutil.AccessDenied. The native notification layer converts observer exceptions to NATIVE_COMMAND_PROTOCOL_FAILED; the outer wrapper retained only the later readiness-not-observed error.
